notes: P2 challenges the Ta-vacancy assignment and the mapping of the 5 defect types onto 4 surface sites plus 1 subsurface site, partly covering C1 and C2 without specifically advocating 5 Te-vacancy sites. P8 questions the exclusivity of the Ta-vacancy charge/dipole argument relative to Pd and Te vacancies and asks why monopole-predicted filled-state bound states are absent at trivial defects, partly covering C5 and C19. P5 questions how t = 0.5 eV and mu = -1.5 eV relate to ARPES dispersions, but does not explicitly flag the missing Dirac dispersion (C22) or metallic vs semimetallic normal state (C21).
